story.heading: Our Story
story.intro: KAPU is a neighborhood café and bar in Athens, built around one simple idea: coffee by day, cocktails after dark, always at the same easy pace.
story.body: KAPU has two homes in Athens. KAPU Kypseli, on Zakinthou 9, is the original corner — a café by morning and a cocktail bar by night, with signature drinks and tiki glassware once the sun goes down. KAPU Kallithea, on Menelaou 110, brings the same coffee, food and neighborhood welcome to the other side of the city.
